children: Metagenomi Therapeutics furnished a September 2026 corporate presentation highlighting MGX-001 preclinical durability, safety data and plan to file an IND in Q4 2026.
MGX-001 is designed as a one-time, durable gene integration therapy for hemophilia A with preclinical FVIII in curative range.
Durability shown in NHPs: stable FVIII expression over ~19 months with dose-response and integration correlation.
Off-target assessment in primary human hepatocytes found no off-target edits across 623 tested sites, including supratherapeutic doses.
Pre-IND interaction with FDA completed Dec 2025; IND submission targeted Q4 2026 and first patient dosing planned in 2027.
$120.7 million in cash at end of Q2 2026; runway anticipated to support operations through Q4 2027.

title: Metagenomi Therapeutics advances MGX-001 to IND submission with $120.7M cash runway through Q4 2027
